### 📓 Docs Drift Check
This PR changes **1** package(s): `@objectstack/platform-objects`, touching **34** documentable anchor(s).

**31** hand-written doc(s) name something this change touched — list omitted above 15 rows. Re-derive on the tree named below: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 0368a336dbd6935385b442503b043d937357f4df`.

⛔ **8** release-owned page(s) also affected — read-only, see AGENTS.md Documentation Guardrails.

<details><summary>What this run could not see</summary>

- **1** anchor(s) matched too much of the corpus to be a work list: `sys_user (symbol, 38 pages)`
- the SDK route bridge reached **54** of **206** client-bound route-ledger rows — the other **152** have no registrar `path:` tail to select them, so pages documenting THEIR client methods cannot appear above, on this or any run. Of those **152**: **0** are remediable by widening that discovery convention (an in-repo file declares the path; the convention did not scan it); **55** are structural — on a ledger where NOT ONE row is declared in-repo, so no discovery change reaches them at any price; **97** are undecided (no in-repo declaration, on a ledger that has other in-repo registrars — absence and an unreadable spelling are not distinguishable here). The rows themselves: `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --bridge-coverage`
- a page that states a rule by its **inputs** shares no identifier with the **emitter** that implements the rule, so an emitter-only diff cannot list it — not on this run and not on any run. Measured on #11430: `content/docs/protocol/objectql/types.mdx` documents the text-family column mapping by the ObjectQL type names it maps FROM (`text` / `textarea` / `html`) while the diff changed `createColumn`; it went unlisted, and it was the page that diff falsified, in four places. No shared token exists to detect this on, so a rule your change carries has to be re-read by hand in the pages that restate it.
- a key NAME is not a key, so the hand re-read the line above prescribes can land on the wrong schema. The same spelling is authorable on one governed type and a `[REMOVED]` tombstone on another for each of `active`, `aria`, `joins`, `objects`, `template`, `tools` and `version` (censused on #19093 over the liveness ledger's governed types, top-level keys); nothing in a search result distinguishes the two, so a grep hit on a LIVE example reads as evidence about the DEAD key. Measured on #19059: `content/docs/ai/agents.mdx` was reported as contradicting the `agent.tools` tombstone over its `tools:` example at `:161`, which is inside the `defineSkill({` block opened at `:155` — the page was already correct. Settle ownership by PARSING the value against both schemas, never by the name: that literal PASSES `SkillSchema`, and as an `AgentSchema` it FAILS at `tools` with the tombstone prescription. ⛔ These names are not the whole class — a key retired through a `.strict()` guidance map leaves no tombstone in the walked shape and none of them here (`tool.category`, live as `AIToolDefinition.category`).

Coarse fallback — **3** page(s) merely *mention* a changed package (the pre-#9192 predicate, kept for the deliberately-wide backstop): `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 0368a336dbd6935385b442503b043d937357f4df` → `packageMentionDocs`.
</details>

<details><summary>Which tree this was computed on</summary>

This run read `content/docs` from `e85907f49743da94871f00ea9e161684d9301ec7` — the merge of head `d616c8cc3f875fbd993787920c60160ccc0c2d68` into base `0368a336dbd6935385b442503b043d937357f4df`, which is what `actions/checkout` gives a `pull_request` run. **Not** the PR head.

A worktree cut from an older `main` holds a different `content/docs`, so re-deriving there can legitimately return a different list — that is a **different tree, not a wrong row**. To answer on the same tree:

```sh
# while this PR is open — GitHub drops the merge commit once it closes
git fetch origin e85907f49743da94871f00ea9e161684d9301ec7 && git checkout e85907f49743da94871f00ea9e161684d9301ec7
# afterwards, rebuild it from the two parents, which stay fetchable
git fetch origin 0368a336dbd6935385b442503b043d937357f4df d616c8cc3f875fbd993787920c60160ccc0c2d68 && git checkout -B drift-repro 0368a336dbd6935385b442503b043d937357f4df && git merge --no-ff d616c8cc3f875fbd993787920c60160ccc0c2d68

node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs --json 0368a336dbd6935385b442503b043d937357f4df
```

⚠️ That checkout carried **uncommitted changes**, so the commit above does not fully identify what was read.
</details>

> Advisory only, and a **precision-first** one (#9192): a page is listed because it names a
> symbol, wire route or SDK method this diff touched — not because it mentions a changed
> package. Each row says which anchor put it there, so a wrong row is reportable rather than
> merely annoying. To re-verify, run the `docs-accuracy-audit` workflow scoped to these files:
> `node scripts/docs-audit/affected-docs.mjs 0368a336dbd6935385b442503b043d937357f4df` → pass the list as
> `args.docs`, on the commit named under **Which tree this was computed on**.

## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `d616c8cc3f875fbd993787920c60160ccc0c2d68`
Local-runs: none

Inputs, and nothing else: card #20493 body and all three comments (triage 5877552039, claim 5880394970, os-dev-report 5881052776); PR #20530 body, its 8-file list and the net diff against merge-base `fb386074f` (read-only `git fetch`, `git show`, `git diff`, `git log`, `git grep`); the check-runs on the head, read twice (first read 00:20Z, final read 2026-09-29T00:28:43Z, below); the precedent PR #20490 body, its review 5876239898 and delta 5876450868, and the #20462 thread; objectui `main` `12a6688cb` `packages/i18n/src/locales/ja.ts` and `es.ts` for the console words. The three locale bundles, the en bundle and the two provenance companions were parsed from blobs in scratch (node and python over `git show` output) at base and head. No worktree, checkout, build, test, gate or ablation.

### ① Derived judgments

1. **Structure untouched in both bundles.** Key sets are identical base to head and identical to `en` in both locales, 1529 string leaves each. `ja-JP.objects.generated.ts`: 340 leaf values change, 0 keys added, removed or renamed; `es-ES.objects.generated.ts`: 338 / 0. Every changed leaf was byte-equal to its `en` leaf at base (0 authored translations overwritten, both locales), none equals `en` at head, and every new ja-JP value carries kana or kanji. The bundle diffs are exactly 340 and 338 one-line pairs (no header or comment moved), and `en.objects.generated.ts` and `zh-CN.objects.generated.ts` are blob-identical base to head. RIGHT: leaf values only, as the claim requires; `check:i18n` is green on the head (Lint and Repo Gates).
2. **The companions were regenerated, not hand-edited.** `ja-JP.source-hashes.generated.ts`: 383 rows to 43, 340 removed, 0 added, 0 digests changed; `es-ES`: 392 to 54, 338 removed, 0 added, 0 changed; rows sorted at both revisions. The removed rows are exactly the changed leaves in both locales. At base the rows equal the byte-copies (383 / 392); at head the remaining rows equal the remaining byte-copies AND each ledger's declared echo set (43 / 54), set difference empty in both directions. RIGHT: a faithful `pnpm i18n:extract` output. The ledgers assert one direction per verdict (every echo has its row; no pinned translation has one; the table is non-empty); the equality is measured here and deliberately not asserted, as each header says.
3. **Each locale's English-by-design set, every declared echo read with its reason.** ja-JP 43: 7 sign-in brands (the bundle keeps Okta, Entra and Auth0 verbatim, each present); 23 bare `ID` labels (the bundle carries ユーザー ID ×4, 組織 ID, クライアント ID ×9); `JWKS` / `JWKS URI` (both `help` leaves ARE translated in this diff; 署名キー (JWKS) ×2 and リダイレクト URI ×4 present); `Web` (the sibling `fields.type.options.web` reads Web at base, authored); `IdP SSO URL` (siblings IdP エンティティ ID / IdP 署名証明書 authored); the 4 typed placeholders (OIDC scope and claim names, the SAML NameID URN; the authored help 既定値は「email」 present); `Message-ID` (the authored help keeps it); `Cc` / `Bcc` (Japanese mail clients print these in Latin letters; 送信元 / 宛先 are authored at base and `Reply-To` is authored 返信先 ×2 in this diff); `UI` / `API` (API キー ×13, UI には表示されません, `sys_metadata.fields.source.options.api` reads API). All real by-design keeps; no ordinary label hides among them. es-ES 54: the same 40 minus `IdP SSO URL` (authored in es at base, per the set logic in ②) plus fourteen Spanish-as-written rows, each precedent found: `Error` ×2 (Último error ×2), `Actor` ×3 (Último actor que escribió esta fila; the service-messaging es-ES bundle authors its actor label `Actor`, line 38), `Global` ×2 (the plugin-security es-ES bundle's authored help "nulo = global (entre inquilinos)", line 425; siblings Inquilino / Usuario authored), `Variables (JSON)` ((asunto + contenido + variables) present), `Token` ×2 (Token de sesión ×2, Token de acceso), `Checksum` ×2 (Checksum anterior), `Slug` (Cambiar slug; objectui es.ts "Ese slug ya está en uso", "Slug de URL"), `Cc` (the blind-copy sibling is authored Cco at base). Each is a word Spanish spells the same or a loanword the bundle already uses for the concept. No skipped user-facing translation is declared as an echo in either locale, and no undeclared copy remains (item 2). RIGHT.
4. **Translation quality: all 340 and 338 changed leaves were read, not a sample** (ja-JP label 181, options 10, pluralLabel 12, help 121, description 12, emptyState 4; es-ES 179 / 10 / 12 / 121 / 12 / 4), including every option value (delegated_admin on both objects, severity info / warning / critical, managed_by platform / package / admin, lock_state no-overlay / no-delete) and every `help` against its `en`. No mistranslation found; no help text's meaning changed. Terminology follows the bundles' authored words, every precedent the PR names found: ja-JP 作成日時 (34 to 44) / 更新日時 / 有効期限 / 失効日時 / ローテーション日時, クライアント ID, スコープ, クレーム (マッピング: メールクレーム at base), プロビジョニング, 投影 and 付与 (sys_scim_projection_grant's display_title), リース and 冪等キー, トピック / 重大度 / 情報・警告・重大 / 操作者 (all in the service-messaging ja-JP bundle), ポジション (plugin-security ja-JP bundle, 29 hits), 所属組織 (`ja-JP.ts:22` nav_account_memberships), 配属 (objectui ja.ts placementLabel); es-ES Creado el / Actualizado el / Caduca el / Revocado el / Rotado el, ID de cliente, Ámbitos, reclamo (Mapeo: reclamo de correo at base), aprovisionamiento (Aprovisionada por IdP), concesión (Tipos de concesión), arrendamiento, Tema / Severidad / Información · Advertencia · Crítica (service-messaging es-ES bundle), Puesto (plugin-security, 11 hits), principal, Mis organizaciones (`es-ES.ts:22`), Asignación (objectui es.ts placementLabel). One term one rendering, measured mechanically over all 1529 leaves: en values rendered two ways in a group touching a changed leaf are ja-JP 2 (`Label`: ラベル, siding with the pre-existing ラベル on sys_view_definition against the pre-existing authored 表示名 on sys_email_template; `Locked Until`, disclosed) and es-ES 3 (`Active` Activo / Activa and `All` Todos / Todas, grammatical gender agreement with each object's noun, which the bundle already did at base and Spanish requires; `Label` Etiqueta against the pre-existing Nombre visible). Bundle-wide, en values rendered two ways fell from 32 to 10 (ja-JP) and 34 to 13 (es-ES); this PR adds no new pair. Nits, none blocking: ja `sys_scim_identity_tombstone.label` renders Identity as ID (SCIM ID トゥームストーン; ID doubles for identity in Japanese IT usage and the description reads SCIM ID likewise); ja `sys_email_template.fields.managed_by.label` 管理者 equals its own `admin` option 管理者 (③.4); two es labels are full clauses (El arrendamiento de la retirada caduca el; La reproducción de la rotación caduca el), faithful but long; es lápida (tombstone) and compuerta (gate) are literal and consistent, and lápida is already the service-storage es-ES bundle's word.
5. **The objectui words.** objectui `main` `12a6688cb` (2026-09-28T23:52Z): `ja.ts:2689` `organization.roles.delegatedAdmin: '委任管理者'`, `es.ts:2691` `'Administrador delegado'`. The head bundles read 委任管理者 / Administrador delegado on both `sys_member` and `sys_invitation` (measured), and each ledger asserts `sys_invitation` options toEqual `sys_member`'s, four distinct words, Japanese script (ja) or not-the-en-source (es), and the exact console word. RIGHT. The other three roles agree with objectui in es (Propietario / Administrador / Miembro); in ja the pre-existing authored owner leaf reads 所有者 where objectui reads オーナー, not this card's leaf, noted only.
6. **The sibling ledger edit.** `sys_oauth_resource.fields.access_token_ttl.label` was a byte copy in ja-JP and es-ES at base and is translated here (アクセストークン TTL / TTL del token de acceso), so the old ja / es branch (value equals en, provenance row present) would red on this head: the edit is required by a leaf this card translated. The new loop asserts, for every locale, value not equal to en, `carriesToken(value, 'TTL')` and no provenance row: the zh-CN assertions are unchanged and ja / es now carry the same authored-state assertions zh-CN got in #20490. Nothing weakened. Of the 39 objects-bundle leaf paths the eleven sibling ledgers reference, only this one is in the changed set, and none remains a byte copy at head; the other eight ledgers' provenance floors have been greater than 0 since #20490 and their `authored.length` floors only grow. RIGHT; Test Core 1/6 to 6/6 green.
7. **The before / after counts.** Recomputed from the blobs with the PR's stated method (byte-equal string leaves at the same path, 1529 per bundle): ja-JP 383 to 43 (label 210 to 29, options 20 to 10, pluralLabel 12 to 0, help 121 to 0, description 12 to 0, placeholder 4 to 4, emptyState 4 to 0; label plus options 230 to 39); es-ES 392 to 54 (217 to 38, 22 to 12, 12 to 0, 121 to 0, 12 to 0, 4 to 4, 4 to 0; 239 to 50). Every cell of the PR table matches. The en, ja-JP, es-ES bundles and both companions are byte-identical at the PR's base `397572ed5`, the card's `b810ddb6f` and the merge-base `fb386074f`, so H1 holds.
8. **The two ledgers** are the zh-CN shape applied per locale: `Verdict = 'translate' | 'echo'`, `Decision` with en-pinned rows, reason greater than 40 characters on every row, `departure` on every echo, `undeclaredEchoes` proved on a synthetic row, the dark predicate tests, the provenance both-directions test (11 tests ja, 10 es, consistent with the dev's ablation counts). ja adds a JAPANESE script predicate with its own dark test; es, having no script to test, uses the en catalog as the negative in the role test; both add the exact console-word pin inside the existing role test. No new mechanism. Type Check lanes green.
9. **H5 class decision.** `packages/cli/src/utils/i18n-extract.ts:1192-1193` file a field's `help` and `placeholder` under source `'field'`, line 1177 files `description` under `'object'`: the same class as the element's label. RIGHT to translate help / description / emptyState; the four placeholders are typed literals and stay (4 to 4, all four declared echoes).
10. **Size and surface.** 8 files, +1416 / −1371 = 2787 changed lines, under the 5000 human-merge threshold; every file inside the claim 5880394970 (leaf-only bundles, two ledgers, two regenerated companions, one sibling ledger that reads a translated leaf, one changeset); no zh-CN, no `*.metadata-forms.generated.ts`, no hand-authored `ja-JP.ts` / `es-ES.ts`, no `scripts/i18n-coverage-baseline.json`. Governed Surface Queue Guard and the single-writer-path guard green.

Gate verdicts, final read 2026-09-29T00:28:43Z: 34 check-runs on the head, all completed: 31 success, 3 skipped (Build Docs, Console Pin Gate, Packed-tarball smoke: path / opt-in skips), 0 in progress, 0 failed. Success: Lint and Repo Gates (the `check:i18n` family) at 00:18:48Z; Test Core rollup and 1/6 to 6/6; Type Check workspace / source gates / consumer gates / debt ledger and TypeScript Type Check; Build Core; Check Changeset; Dogfood Regression Gate rollup and 1/3 to 3/3; Dogfood Verify CLI; Temporal Conformance (live PG + MySQL); Governed Surface Queue Guard; The card this PR closes must claim this branch; No other open PR may claim the same issue / the same single-writer path; Part-of PR must not also close its card; Check PR Size; Check Documentation Links; Flag docs affected by code changes; Auto Label; filter. `mergeable: true`, `mergeable_state: clean`; the PR is still a draft.

### ② Semver level

`.changeset/20493-ja-es-object-labels.md` declares `@objectstack/platform-objects: patch`. RIGHT: the diff changes 678 string values inside two published generated bundles, drops 678 provenance rows, adds two test files and edits one; no export, type, key, schema or API moves, and nothing a consumer's code binds to changes. A copy fix in user-visible text is a patch. `Clause-②: no` in the claim, the changeset and the PR body; right, no forward-compat lever, flag or removal is involved. Check Changeset is green.

Changeset sentences: the title sentence TRUE in the sense its third bullet qualifies (the 340 / 338 copies are gone; the 43 / 54 that remain are declared by design). `Clause-②: no` TRUE. The symptom sentence TRUE per the card (bundle read, not re-driven in a browser). "byte copies of the English source that `os i18n extract --fill=default` seeds" TRUE (`--fill=default` is in the root `i18n:extract` script; byte-equal at base). "ja-JP: 340 of the 383 … labels, plural labels, select options, help, descriptions and empty states" TRUE, numbers and class list (no placeholder translated). "`delegated_admin` reads 委任管理者 on both … the word the console already uses" TRUE. "es-ES: 338 of the 392 … Administrador delegado on both objects, again the console's word" TRUE. "The rest stay as written by design, each recorded with its reason in a per-locale ledger" TRUE. "ja-JP keeps 43: brands, the bare ID, protocol names (JWKS, IdP SSO URL, Message-ID, UI / API), the Web client type, the Cc / Bcc header abbreviations, and placeholders" TRUE (7 + 23 + 2 + 1 + 1 + 2 + 1 + 2 + 4 = 43). "es-ES keeps 54: the same brands, ID, JWKS, Message-ID, UI / API, Web and placeholders, plus … (Error, Actor, Global, Variables), … (Token, Checksum, Slug) and Cc" TRUE (40 + 8 + 5 + 1 = 54; IdP SSO URL correctly absent). The companions bullet ("regenerated by `pnpm i18n:extract` … now list exactly those 43 and 54. zh-CN is unchanged") TRUE, measured.

PR-body sentences: "Fixes #20493" TRUE, the only closing keyword. The what-changed paragraph and its bullets (340 / 43, 338 / 54, leaf values only, structure untouched, two ledgers of the zh-CN shape with no new mechanism, companions −340 / −338 and 0 added with the remainder set-equal to the echoes, one sibling ledger followed and the other eight needing no edit, zh-CN / metadata-forms / hand-authored files / objectui untouched) each TRUE, measured above; "`pnpm i18n:extract` re-read both bundles byte-identical" is the dev's local reading, consistent with Lint and Repo Gates green. The coverage-ratchet paragraph TRUE (no baseline in the diff; neither ledger asserts the table is a subset of the echoes). The pinned-strings table TRUE, every cell. "The console's words were read at objectui `main` `797a30f`": the words TRUE at current `main` `12a6688cb`; that sha itself is not re-measurable now that `main` has moved. "The role test also asserts the four role words are distinct, identical on both objects, Japanese-script in ja-JP and none equal to its `en` source in es-ES" TRUE. The count section: every sentence and cell TRUE, including "All three bundles have 1529 leaves", the base `397572ed5` and the H1 reproduction. The H5 sentence TRUE (①.9). The ja-JP echo table: every row's leaves, values and reasons TRUE against the bundle, and the departures paragraph TRUE (クライアント ID / クライアントシークレット authored at base, 9 hits each; Web and Cc / Bcc absent from the zh-CN ledger). The es-ES echo table: every row TRUE (①.3), and the departures sentence TRUE. Terminology bullets: every precedent TRUE (①.4) except one parenthesis: "tombstone is トゥームストーン (no prior rendering in any ja-JP bundle)" is FALSE in its parenthesis, since the service-storage ja-JP objects bundle already renders トゥームストーン (line 97); the word chosen is therefore the existing rendering, which is better than the sentence claims. Non-blocking. The verification section's local runs are the dev's and are not re-measured here; every CI-declared family is green on the head; "a true merge of `origin/main` `fb386074f` (parents `8f3e7cae3`, `fb386074f`)" TRUE; "H6 … 2787 changed lines (+1416 / −1371) over 8 files" TRUE. Acceptance notes: each TRUE, judged in ③.

### ③ Boundary flags

1. Deviation 1, a third pinned `translate` row (`sys_team.fields.member_count.label`) beyond the claim's `delegated_admin` pair: the leaf was a byte copy in both locales and is translated (メンバー数 / Número de miembros); the row is an extra assertion of the zh-CN shape, harmless and on-surface. Accepted, no escalation.
2. Deviation 2, the console-word pin as an exact-value assertion inside the role test rather than a new `Decision` field: satisfies the claim's pin and keeps the ledger shape identical to zh-CN's. Accepted.
3. Deviation 3, es-ES has no script to test, so its `translate` verdict asserts not-the-en-source and the role test uses the en catalog as the negative: the only honest predicate for a Latin-script locale; the exact-word pin and the distinctness assertion cover the card's leaves. Accepted.
4. Deviation 4, the model-free trailer pair per AGENTS.md instead of the harness reminder's model-named trailer: every PR commit carries `Claude-Session:` and `Co-authored-by: Claude`; "The card this PR closes must claim this branch" and Lint and Repo Gates are green. A process note, no action.
5. Deviation 5, cleanup after the report: process only, no effect on the diff.
6. `open_questions` is empty; nothing to answer.
7. Out-of-scope note 1 (es `Parent` as principal; the pre-existing `parent_business_unit_id` / `primary_business_unit_id` pair both read Unidad de negocio principal): measured TRUE at base and untouched; this PR's Organización principal follows the bundle's word. No defect introduced; carrier none agreed. A bundle-wide Parent / Primary disambiguation would be its own card if the maintainer wants one.
8. Out-of-scope note 2 (authored ja / es leaves stale against a moved `en` source, e.g. `sys_two_factor.fields.backup_codes.help` still "JSON-serialized" where `en` now says an opaque ciphertext, and `sys_notification.description`): measured TRUE at base and head in both locales; pre-existing, outside the copy class, legacy-trusted by the provenance design's own ruling. Not this PR's defect. The backup_codes help now states the opposite of the source, so the seat may file one bare card for the present-but-stale class with the dev's dedupe words; not a blocker here.
9. Out-of-scope note 3 (`Locked Until` rendered two ways in ja-JP already; this PR uses sys_user's ロック解除日時 for sys_two_factor): pre-existing pair, the same side #20490 took for zh-CN. No defect introduced.
10. Out-of-scope note 4 (ja `Managed By` is 管理者, so `sys_email_template` reads 管理者 as the label and as its `admin` option): this is the one note whose surface IS new in this PR, since `sys_metadata` (whose authored label 管理者 the PR follows) has no `admin` option and so never collided. The meaning is recoverable from the option set (プラットフォーム / パッケージ / 管理者), zh-CN and es-ES do not collide (管理方 / 管理员; Gestionado por / Administrador), and the alternative 管理元 would render `Managed By` two ways unless the authored `sys_metadata` label (outside the copy class) moved with it. Non-blocking; the maintainer's one-line choice, recommended as a text-only follow-up on both labels rather than a re-review trigger.
11. Out-of-scope note 5 (the eight sibling ledgers' floor comments name only zh-CN): comment-only drift outside the file surface; the floors hold for all three locales at head. No action.
12. The PR-body slip in ② (the tombstone parenthesis): one FALSE parenthesis in a terminology bullet, no value or assertion behind it; drop the parenthesis if the branch is re-pushed for any other reason.
